original_test_intent: Build an approved ROCm/RVS stack, run the specified single-GPU GST validation with debug level 3, and prove results match the GPU specification with no errors and all checks true.
original_method: Use immutable reviewed ROCm and RVS revisions and toolchain, verify GPU/driver compatibility and config contents, build reproducibly, run exactly `../bin/rvs -c conf/gst_single.conf -d 3` under bounded thermal/power/watchdog supervision, parse every action/result and inspect logs.
manual_activity: GPU validation owner pins artifacts/config/spec limits, approves build/run window and safety envelope, watches OOB recovery and sets verdict.
required_inputs: Pinned ROCm and RVS revisions/checksums/source review
Expected per-action results/performance and error oracle
Cooling/power limits, timeout/abort, OOB and cleanup plan
safety_requirements: Build in an isolated controlled environment
Verify signatures/hashes and no unreviewed network fetch at execution
Confirm cooling and stable power before GST
Monitor temperature/power/ECC/MCE/PCIe and retain OOB access
Single attempt; abort on threshold, hang, driver reset or unexpected error and recover deliberately
agent_execution_scope: Verify inputs and reproduce approved build
Run the exact bounded gst_single command
Capture every action/result plus health telemetry/logs
Stop safely and report; do not install arbitrary latest code or decide DUT result
engineer_actions: Approve sources, config, target and specification oracle
Review all true/error/performance/health results and determine outcome

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its generic long RVS statement loses required build provenance, exact gst_single command and per-result evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After immutable build approval, execute `../bin/rvs -c conf/gst_single.conf -d 3` once with an external watchdog and capture structured per-action outcomes and synchronized platform health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact config, debug level 3, build steps and source 5/5 estimate are preserved; runtime must be measured and bounded rather than guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a build bill of materials, hash the produced binary/config, preflight the selected GPU, then run once under independent monitoring and parse each RVS action against an approved oracle.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes moving-source builds reproducible and the broad all-true/no-error/spec criteria auditable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not substitute package installation alone or a different RVS suite/config.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: RVS true flags do not independently establish performance compliance unless expected metric limits are supplied.

project_override_considerations: Project owner selects immutable compatible ROCm/RVS revisions and defines which gst_single actions and quantitative GPU-spec limits are authoritative.
expected_evidence: Approved source revisions/checksums/licenses/toolchain and build logs
Parsed action-by-action true/error/metric table against spec
Cleanup/recovery, anomaly dispositions and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source intent is coherent; the doubled opening quote is a command transcription defect and DeepSeek is incomplete rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Pinned sources, config, limits and safety approvals are project prerequisites that can be supplied.

review_improvement: Converts an unpinned build-and-run instruction into a reproducible, bounded RVS action-level validation while retaining the exact gst_single scope.
independent_technical_reasoning: Building latest ROCm and RVS makes executable, dependencies and expected output move together, so a later rerun cannot explain a changed result. The config selects workload and targets and must be treated as an input artifact. A global search for `true` can miss skipped or duplicate actions; acceptance needs a complete expected-action roster and quantitative GPU-spec checks under independent safety monitoring.
